entities.summary: Hermann Wilhelm Berning was the Roman Catholic Bishop of Osnabrück from 1914 to his death in 1955. Politically, he was a conservative and a German nationalist and his attitude toward the Nazi regime is a matter of controversy among historians. Wilhelm Berning was a religious figures from Lingen (1877, Lingen–1955-11-23). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
